title: Docs are json, per location, with one registry

adr.context: Docs were half markdown, half leftovers, with no registry, and the root held docs that belong to main.
adr.decision: Each location owns a docs folder with a map, its docs, an adr and a glossary. A registry in the root points at the maps. Docs are json read by one viewer. The root's docs moved to main.
consequences: Markdown moves to `.old-markdown-to-sunset` in each location and is deleted when the conversion is ready.
Converted docs have empty axioms and purpose until written.
Removing a location breaks its import in the registry.
